Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner's initial plan to use WebSurfer to search for the individual known as "Aladin" and who helped organizations improve performance as a consultant failed to effectively narrow down the search parameters. The Planner did not sufficiently emphasize or prioritize validating the consulting aspect of the problem, instead allowing the search to focus too broadly on individuals with the name "Aladin" or similar variants. This led to repeated iterations of inconclusive WebSurfer searches without addressing the core requirement of identifying credible evidence linking the stage name "Aladin" to performance-improvement consulting work. The Planner should have designed a more focused strategy, such as directing WebSurfer to validate credible biographical sources or professional profiles with explicit ties to consulting and organizational performance improvement.
